notes: This contract pins the bounded embedded transportation-type control implementation to the exact IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ API surfaces exported by the Requirements Lab. It covers the three attribute RTIambassador services and their two FederateAmbassador callbacks plus the two interaction RTIambassador services and their two callbacks. Predefined and execution-scoped FOM transportation handles are resolved through the composed federation catalog. It is source/API traceability only: no protected-review, JUnit, package, or conformance claim is made.
